_doc: GARUDA-FILIERA metadata-residuals micro-fix (2026-07-19, M5 lane) — closes 2 field-vs-note contradictions PR #2777 left on main. #2777 (merged 2026-07-18) shipped 3 standalone metadata-fix cures (46100/52101/10433, the PR #2753 residual scope) via cure_canonical_collisions.py's 'action':'metadata_only' + pp28_sources_correction/status_mapping_correction/whatChanged_correction extension. 46100 is fully conformant. Two records shipped with their _data_note already stating a truth the corresponding FIELD still contradicted (a genuine field-vs-note gap, not a new finding): 52101's note+whatChanged correctly name the true five-parent BPS crosswalk merge, but pp28_sources was left at the false same-digit self-reference ['52101']; 10433's note correctly explains the true 1:1 continuation (10490 belongs to a DIFFERENT 2025 code, 10419), but status_mapping/whatChanged were left at the stale 'MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE'/'match con aggregazione' shape. Both were explicitly flagged as 'known follow-up, not silently left undocumented' inside #2777's own _data_note prose — this spec ships exactly those two follow-ups, nothing else. Convention ruling (conductor comment on PR #2777, 2026-07-19, posted by Balizero1987/owner): correct FALSITY in the pointer/label, using the SAME already-image-verified BPS Lampiran citation already cited in the existing _data_note — not a fresh independent PP28-corpus hunt, same class as the #2754/56101 precedent. Uses the SAME compiler (cure_canonical_collisions.py) and the SAME 'action':'metadata_only' entry-type PR #2777 already shipped and tested — zero compiler extension needed. Does NOT modify #2777's own merged spec file (scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_specs/metadata_fixes_2026_07_19.json) — this is a separate, additive spec. Per team convention, each entry's data_note APPENDS a residual-fix sentence to the EXISTING #2777 note verbatim (never erases it) — the evidence trail from #2777's own conductor gate stays intact.
_provenance: Conductor comment on PR #2777 (github.com/Balizero1987/Teman2/pull/2777, author Balizero1987/owner, posted 2026-07-19): '[M5 conductor — post-merge content verification + micro-fix claim] Verified #2777's trio cures by content on main. 46100: fully conformant... Two SMALL residuals found, both cases where the record's own _data_note (correctly) states a truth the FIELD still contradicts: 1. 52101: note+whatChanged record the five-parent merge... but pp28_sources still ["52101"]... Per the #2754/56101 precedent this is FALSITY in the pointer list (not incompleteness) -> correct to the true ancestor list. 2. 10433: pp28_sources correctly shrunk to ["10433"] but status_mapping remains MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE and whatChanged says match con aggregazione with a SINGLE ancestor... -> MATCH_LANGSUNG + whatChanged fixed. M5 claims the micro-fix PR.' Source citations (already image-verified, cited verbatim in the pre-existing _data_note this spec appends to, not re-verified independently in this pass): 52101 BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10 p.403 (printed p.389), 10433 BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10 p.340 (printed p.326), both render-cited in PR #2753's Lot 2 conductor gate report (second signing + Appendix A, 2026-07-18). BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b.

codes.whatChanged_correction: Renumbered/merged from KBLI 2020 52108 + fishery post-harvest services codes — activity scope from 52108, code number reused (corrected 2026-07-19 — the previous 'Direct 1:1 match... code and scope unchanged' label was a false narrative). BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10 (image-verified p.389, render lampiran10_p403-403.png) documents a FIVE-parent merge: KBLI-2020 codes 03143, 03241, 03243, 03263 (fishery post-harvest/production services) and 52108 (same-title SRG warehouse manager) all map to KBLI-2025 52101 — the false same-digit self-reference ['52101'] previously left in pp28_sources is now corrected to this true 5-parent ancestor list (residual fix, 2026-07-19).
codes.data_note: KBLI 2025 code 52101 'Pengelola Gudang Sistem Resi Gudang' (warehouse-receipt-system / SRG warehouse manager) carries canonical status_mapping='MATCH_LANGSUNG' and intel_2026.whatChanged='Direct 1:1 match from KBLI 2020 — code and scope unchanged.' — both FALSE. This code was enrolled as a Lot 2 innocence CONTROL; the lane flagged it and the conductor image-verified BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10 p.389 (render lampiran10_p403-403.png, Lot 2 conductor gate report §3.3, 2026-07-18) BY EYE: 52101-2025 is a FIVE-parent MERGE — KBLI-2020 codes 03143, 03241, 03243, 03263 (fishery post-harvest/production services) AND 52108 (same-title SRG warehouse manager) all map to KBLI-2025 52101 — not a direct 1:1 continuation. Its per_skala (8 rows) is HEALTHY OSS-native licensing, verified byte-for-byte against live OSS by the Lot 2 seat, and is NOT detached by this cure ('action':'metadata_only' — per_skala stays completely untouched regardless of its non-empty state). status_mapping corrected to 'MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE' (the merge-aware enum value, already used 195+ times elsewhere in the dataset); intel_2026.whatChanged corrected to name the true parents. pp28_sources REMAINS ['52101'] UNCHANGED — a bare-number cross-vintage collision (the PP28 I.G row for '52101' describes the 2020 meaning, general warehousing/Rendah/NIB, not the 2025 SRG-manager/Tinggi-risk regime): fixing it would require an independent re-hunt of the PP28 corpus under the 5 true 2020 parents to establish a verified replacement source, which has NOT been performed in this session — forcing a pp28_sources change here without that provenance would violate rule #9 (no new values without provenance). This compiler's pp28_sources_correction capability (added in this same PR, first used on 10433 below) is therefore deliberately NOT applied to 52101; recorded here as a known follow-up, not silently left undocumented. Lot 2 conductor gate (second signing), 2026-07-18. BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b. RESIDUAL FIX (2026-07-19, M5 lane, field-vs-note contradiction closure, conductor comment on PR #2777): pp28_sources corrected from the false same-digit self-reference ['52101'] to the true 5-parent list ['03143','03241','03243','03263','52108'] this note already asserted. The rule-9 caution above (an independent PP28-corpus re-hunt) is resolved by conductor ruling: this is a FALSITY correction of the crosswalk pointer using the SAME already-image-verified BPS Lampiran 10 p.403/389 citation already cited above, not a fresh independent PP28-corpus hunt — same class as the #2754/56101 precedent (correct falsity in the pointer list; incompleteness alone would only warrant a note). status_mapping and whatChanged's substance were already correct from #2777; only whatChanged's closing sentence ('pp28_sources remains unchanged') is updated here to match the now-corrected field. aggregation_note (currently null/None) is intentionally left untouched by this residual fix — cure_canonical_collisions.py's metadata_only action does not write that field (same as it did not for 46100/52101 in #2777); flagged here, not silently left undocumented, as a possible follow-up for a future pass.

codes.judul: Industri Pemisahan/Fraksinasi Minyak Mentah Kelapa Sawit dan Minyak Mentah Inti Kelapa Sawit
codes.whatChanged_correction: KBLI 2020->2025 mapping: direct 1:1 match (10433->10433). Corrected 2026-07-19 — the previous 'match con aggregazione' status_mapping/label was stale: it depended on a second parent (2020 code 10490) that was already removed from pp28_sources by PR #2777, since 10490's true 2025 child is 10419, not 10433. With only one true ancestor remaining, this is a clean 1:1 continuation.
codes.data_note: KBLI 2025 code 10433 'Industri Pemisahan/Fraksinasi Minyak Mentah Kelapa Sawit dan Minyak Mentah Inti Kelapa Sawit' (CPO/PKO crude-oil fractionation industry) carries canonical pp28_sources=['10433','10490'], asserting BOTH KBLI-2020 codes 10433 and 10490 as its licensing basis. This code was sampled as a Lot 2 cross-family POSITIVE ('clean') gold control (Appendix A) and DISQUALIFIED: the conductor image-verified BPS Vol.2 Lampiran 10 printed p.326 (render lampiran10_p340-340.png, Lot 2 conductor gate report Appendix A, 2026-07-18) BY EYE: '10419 (2025) <- 10490 (2020)' and '10433 (2025) <- 10433 (2020)' are SEPARATE rows — 10490 is the SOLE KBLI-2020 ancestor of a DIFFERENT 2025 code, 10419 'Industri Minyak Mentah dan Lemak Nabati dan Hewani Bukan Kelapa dan Kelapa Sawit Lainnya' (independently verified live in this session: 10419's own canonical kbli_2020_source='10490', pp28_sources=['10490']), not a co-parent of 10433. The canonical pp28_sources=['10433','10490'] on 10433 therefore associates 10490 with the WRONG child code — the THIRD contaminated 'clean' control found that session (after 52101 and 46100), all on the crosswalk-metadata layer. Its per_skala (4 rows) is HEALTHY OSS-native licensing, unaffected by this crosswalk-pointer defect, and is NOT detached by this cure ('action':'metadata_only' — per_skala stays completely untouched regardless of its non-empty state). pp28_sources corrected to ['10433'] — 10490 REMOVED (it is recorded here as belonging to 10419, never re-added to 10433). status_mapping ('MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE') and intel_2026.whatChanged are left UNCHANGED by this cure: a single-element pp28_sources under a 'MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE' status_mapping is an already-precedented dataset convention (47771, 52101, 60101, 60103 all carry the same shape — pp28_sources tracks the PP28-licensing-basis pointer only, separate from the full BPS crosswalk-ancestor narrative, which lives in prose), so no inconsistency is introduced; whether the merge-aware status_mapping label itself needs re-adjudication (given the 'aggregation' this code originally cited turns out, per this same finding, to have been built on a false co-parent) is flagged here as a known follow-up, not silently left undocumented — the scope of this cure is the pp28_sources removal only, per the task that authored it. This is the FIRST use of the pp28_sources_correction compiler capability, added in this same PR (scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_canonical_collisions.py), mirroring the status_mapping_correction/whatChanged_correction pattern shipped for 47771 in PR #2761. Lot 2 conductor gate (second signing + Appendix A), 2026-07-18. BPS Vol.2 sha 29f17b3b. RESIDUAL FIX (2026-07-19, M5 lane, field-vs-note contradiction closure, conductor comment on PR #2777): the 'known follow-up' flagged above ('whether the merge-aware status_mapping label itself needs re-adjudication') is now resolved — status_mapping corrected from 'MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE' to 'MATCH_LANGSUNG' and whatChanged corrected to a clean 1:1 narrative, since 10490 (the co-parent this code's aggregation status depended on) belongs to 10419, not 10433: 2025-10433 is a genuine 1:1 continuation of 2020-10433 alone. pp28_sources is UNCHANGED by this residual fix (already correct at ['10433'] from #2777). aggregation_note (currently 'Dati da 10433 + 1 codici figli PP28', now stale — it describes a 2-source merge that no longer exists) is intentionally left untouched by this residual fix — cure_canonical_collisions.py's metadata_only action does not write that field; flagged here, not silently left undocumented, as a possible follow-up for a future pass.
